scope_note: Incremental public-source update. No investment judgment. sources.description: PAD Aviation strategic investment completion announcement dated 2026-07-06
2026-09-10 close used only as a reference quote; not exchange-audited by the harness

internal_control.issue: Controls over inventory movement within the manufacturing network were not designed and maintained effectively for interim financial reporting.
internal_control.remediation: Enhanced interim inventory counting, system-based and monitoring controls, and strengthened review/approval procedures were implemented during Q2 2026 but require sufficient operating history and testing before remediation can be concluded.
internal_control.financial_statements_management_conclusi: Management concluded the Q2 financial statements fairly present financial position, results and cash flows in all material respects under U.S. GAAP notwithstanding the material weakness.

pad_aviation.fact: TransMedics completed a strategic investment in Germany-based PAD Aviation as the first step toward a dedicated European organ-transplant air logistics network.
pad_aviation.interpretation_limit: Treat as strategic and capital-intensity evidence only; do not infer undisclosed acquisition economics or revenue contribution.
